steps.fact: The left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. corresponds to the billed name "Northbridge Analytics Inc." in billing records.
The right referent contract:MSA-NBA-2021 is a master services agreement whose counterparty is named "Northbridge Analytics, Inc."
Commercial notes state that billing and the MSA both use the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", while sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics".
A 2024 credit check returned a separate Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC", preserving multiple registry candidates.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs to treat the registry link as unresolved.
No shared legal identifier (e.g., registration number, EIN) is present in the packet, and the packet does not license identifier uniqueness for any name.
Shared naming between billing records and the MSA counterparty is name compatibility only; it does not establish legal identity under the grounding contract.

support_claim: The packet preserves multiple registry candidates and explicitly states that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, so identity between the billing referent and the MSA contract counterparty cannot be established.
